seed_rule: 42 + first 7 hex digits of SHA256(task ID) + 1000003 * trial index, incremented per model request
attempts_per_method_per_task: Up to four BF16/SteerDistill samples and eight baseline samples; stop sampling each method after obtaining a usable required outcome.
sample_selection: Successful BF16/SteerDistill samples and failing baseline samples; length limits, missing-tool-list penalties, and AST decoding failures excluded.
scoring_isolation: Fresh Python subprocess for each method and trial wave; no executable-state cache reuse
generation_budget: 32768 total context; 8192 fixed completion tokens; server-side tokenization precheck; over-budget requests excluded
gptq_storage_format: Original IST-DASLab GPTQ Hessian-based algorithm, packed into AWQ GEMM layout without changing its integer codes; see gptq_provenance.json
